INTERNAL_ERROR: An unexpected error occurred. Your data is safe. Try again; if it keeps happening, open the log folder from the Help menu.
FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission for this action.
INVALID_CREDENTIALS: Wrong username or password, or the account is disabled.
USERNAME_TAKEN: That username is already in use.
LAST_ACTIVE_ADMIN: The last active administrator cannot be deactivated or demoted.
LOG_FOLDER_UNAVAILABLE: The log folder could not be opened.
LOAD_FAILED: The application could not load its settings. Close and reopen the application.
CUSTOMER_NAME_OR_PHONE_REQUIRED: Enter the customer name or phone number.
PLATE_EXISTS: That plate number is already registered to another vehicle.
INVALID_BRAND_MODEL: The model does not belong to the selected brand.
REFERENCE_INACTIVE: The selected reference entry is inactive.
REFERENCE_DUPLICATE: That name or code is already in use.
REFERENCE_CODE_IMMUTABLE: The code cannot be changed after creation.
ALREADY_OWNER: This customer already owns the vehicle.
OWNERSHIP_TRANSFER_TOO_SOON: Ownership was just recorded. Wait a moment and try again.
DUPLICATE_SKU: That SKU is already used by another item.
UNKNOWN_BARCODE: Unknown barcode. No item was created.
CATALOG_ITEM_INACTIVE: This item is inactive and cannot be sold.
PRICE_START_CONFLICT: A price already starts at that exact time for this channel. Choose another time, or correct that price instead.
CORRECTION_REASON_REQUIRED: Enter the reason for the correction.
PRICE_CORRECTION_TARGET_INVALID: That price can no longer be corrected. Reload and try again.
PRICE_PREVIEW_STALE: Prices changed since the preview. Review the new preview before applying.
PRICE_PREVIEW_EXPIRED: The preview expired. Preview the change again.
REASON_REQUIRED: Enter the reason for this stock change.
OPENING_BALANCE_EXISTS: This item already has stock history, so an opening balance cannot be set. Use receive, adjust or set stock instead.
ITEM_NOT_INVENTORY_TRACKED: This item does not track inventory (services never move stock).
TRACKING_LOCKED_BY_LEDGER: Inventory tracking cannot be changed because this item already has stock movements.
IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED: This request was already used for a different action. Reload and try again.
SALE_ALREADY_RECORDED: Stock for this invoice and item was already recorded.
SALE_ENTRY_NOT_FOUND: The stock sale entry was not found.
SALE_ALREADY_REVERSED: This sale's stock was already returned.
INVALID_QUANTITY: Enter a whole quantity of at least 1.
DRAFT_DISCARDED: This draft was discarded and can no longer be changed.
INVOICE_NOT_DRAFT: This invoice is no longer a draft.
DRAFT_VERSION_CONFLICT: Someone else changed this draft. Reload it and try again.
PRICE_REQUIRED: This item has no price for the channel and pricing time. Enter a selling price.
UNIT_PRICE_NOT_EXPECTED: This item already has a price. Add it first, then change the price on the line.
DRAFT_PRICE_REFRESH_STALE: Prices changed since the preview. Review the new preview before applying.
MECHANIC_ONLY_FOR_SERVICE: A mechanic can only be assigned to a service line.
LINE_NOT_FOUND: This line no longer exists in the draft.
LINE_TITLE_NOT_EDITABLE: The title of a catalog item cannot be changed on the line.
ALLOCATION_EXCEEDS_AMOUNT: The planned payments exceed the invoice total.
AD_HOC_REFERENCE_NOT_FOUND: The custom item was not found.
AD_HOC_REFERENCE_TYPE_MISMATCH: The custom item has a different type.
INVALID_TOP_DAYS: Enter TOP as a whole number of days (0 or more).
DRAFT_EMPTY: The transaction has no items yet.
INVOICE_DATE_IN_FUTURE: The invoice date {{invoiceDate}} is in the future (today is {{today}}). Change the invoice date.
PRICING_AT_IN_FUTURE: The pricing time is later than now. Change the pricing time to now or earlier.
ZERO_TOTAL_WITH_ALLOCATIONS: The total is zero, so no payment can be recorded. Remove the planned payments.
FINALIZE_WARNINGS_CHANGED: The warnings changed since you reviewed them. Review the checkout again.
PAYMENT_EXCEEDS_OUTSTANDING: The payment is more than the outstanding amount. Enter at most this invoice's remaining balance.
INVOICE_VOID: This invoice is void, so it cannot receive payments.
INVOICE_NOT_FINALIZED: This invoice is not finalized yet. Finish the transaction first.
PAID_INVOICE_CANNOT_BE_VOIDED: An invoice that has received a payment cannot be voided.
VOID_REASON_REQUIRED: Enter a reason for the void.
LOGO_TOO_LARGE: The logo is larger than 512 KB. Choose a smaller image.
LOGO_INVALID_TYPE: The logo must be a PNG or JPEG image.
BACKUP_DESTINATION_UNAVAILABLE: The backup folder is not available. Make sure the USB drive or disk is connected, or choose another folder.
BACKUP_DESTINATION_READ_ONLY: The backup folder cannot be written to. Choose another folder or check its permissions.
BACKUP_WRITE_FAILED: The backup could not be written (the disk may be full). Your data is safe; try again.
BACKUP_VALIDATION_FAILED: The backup copy failed its check and was not kept. Your data is safe; try again.
BACKUP_NOT_FOUND: The backup file was not found or is empty.
NOT_SQLITE: This file is not a Bengkelin database.
FOREIGN_DATABASE: This file belongs to another application, not Bengkelin.
UNSUPPORTED_SCHEMA: This database version is not supported by this version of the application.
MISSING_TABLES: The backup file is incomplete (core tables are missing).
IMPORT_PREVIEW_EXPIRED: The import preview has expired. Choose and check the file again.
IMPORT_PREVIEW_STALE: Data changed after the preview. Check the file again before importing.
IMPORT_HAS_ERRORS: The file still has errors. Fix them and check it again.
IMPORT_BACKUP_FAILED: The safety backup could not be created, so the import was cancelled and nothing changed. Check the backup folder and try again.
INVALID_ENCODING: The file is not valid UTF-8 text. Save it again as "CSV UTF-8".
MALFORMED_CSV: The CSV is malformed (an unmatched or misplaced quote).
FILE_TOO_LARGE: The file is too large (maximum {{maxMegabytes}} MB).
NO_DATA_ROWS: The file only has the header row, with no data.
DUPLICATE_COLUMN: The column "{{column}}" appears more than once.
UNKNOWN_CHANNEL: The column "{{column}}" does not match any channel.
BARCODE_COLUMN_GAP: The column "{{column}}" needs a "{{missing}}" column before it.
INACTIVE_CHANNEL: Channel {{channel}} is inactive; its prices are still saved.
CURRENT_STOCK_IGNORED: The current_stock column is for information only and is ignored on import.
WRONG_DELIMITER: The file uses semicolons (;) instead of commas. In the spreadsheet, save it again as "CSV UTF-8 (comma delimited)", then import it again.
SPREADSHEET_NUMBER_FORMAT: The value "{{value}}" was changed by a spreadsheet into scientific notation, so the original digits are lost. Format the column as Text, type the full value again, and save as CSV.
POSSIBLE_LEADING_ZERO_LOSS: This creates a new item, but the existing SKU "{{existingSku}}" is the same without its leading zeros. A spreadsheet may have removed them; check the SKU before importing.
ROW_WIDTH_MISMATCH: This row has {{actual}} columns; it should have {{expected}}.
SKU_REQUIRED: A SKU is required for imports.
VALUE_TOO_LONG: The value is too long (maximum {{max}} characters).
DUPLICATE_SKU_IN_FILE: This SKU is already used on row {{firstRow}}.
DUPLICATE_BARCODE_IN_FILE: Barcode {{barcode}} is already used on row {{firstRow}}.
BARCODE_OWNED_BY_OTHER_ITEM: Barcode {{barcode}} already belongs to another item ({{ownerSku}} {{ownerTitle}}).
INVALID_TYPE: The type "{{value}}" is not valid (STOCK_ITEM or SERVICE).
UNKNOWN_UNIT: The unit code "{{value}}" is not recognized.
INVALID_PRICE: The price "{{value}}" is not valid (whole rupiah, no separators, at least 0).
INVALID_OPENING_STOCK: The opening stock "{{value}}" is not valid (a whole number, at least 0).
INVALID_BOOLEAN: The value "{{value}}" is not valid (true or false).
TITLE_REQUIRED: A title is required for a new SKU.
TYPE_REQUIRED: A type is required for a new SKU.
UNIT_REQUIRED: A unit is required for a new SKU.
SERVICE_WITH_OPENING_STOCK: Services have no stock; leave opening_stock empty.
OPENING_STOCK_IGNORED: The SKU already exists: opening stock is ignored. Change stock in Inventory.
PRICE_UNCHANGED: Same as the price in force; no new price point.
RESTORE_IN_PROGRESS: A database restore is in progress. Changes cannot be saved until the application restarts.
RESTORE_SAFETY_BACKUP_FAILED: The safety backup could not be created, so the restore was cancelled and nothing changed. Check the backup folder and try again.
RESTORE_MIGRATION_FAILED: This backup cannot be upgraded to the current application version. Nothing changed.
RESTORE_NO_ACTIVE_ADMIN: This backup has no active ADMIN, so nobody could sign in after restoring it. Choose another backup.
RESTORE_TOKEN_EXPIRED: The restore preview has expired. Choose the backup file again.
RESTORE_NOT_CONFIRMED: The restore must be confirmed first.
RESTORE_VALIDATION_FAILED: The backup copy failed its check before restoring. Nothing changed.
RESTORE_FAILED: The restore could not be completed. Your data is intact; if the application restarts, check your data after signing in.
RESTORE_STAGING_FAILED: The backup file could not be copied for checking (the disk may be full). Nothing changed.
RESTORE_BUSY: A save was still running, so the restore was cancelled. Try again in a moment.
VEHICLE_INACTIVE: This vehicle is inactive and cannot be selected. An admin can reactivate it.
CUSTOMER_IMPORT_HEADER: Use the six supported customer CSV columns, without duplicates.
CUSTOMER_IMPORT_INVALID_ROW: Invalid customer row. Check the columns, external ID, field lengths and true/false status.
CUSTOMER_IMPORT_DUPLICATE_ID: External IDs must be unique within the CSV.
CUSTOMER_IMPORT_DUPLICATE_PHONES: Acknowledge duplicate phone numbers before importing.
DUPLICATE_PHONE: This phone number is shared by multiple customers.
REFERENCE_IMPORT_HEADER: CSV columns must match the template.
REFERENCE_IMPORT_INVALID_ROW: Invalid row; check the CSV column count and any indicated field.
EXPORT_FAILED: Could not save the CSV. Try another location.
PRICE_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED: Enter a selling price or explicitly confirm zero for unpriced items.
CHECKOUT_CASH_ONLY: Use the cash payment amount for this invoice.
CASH_PAYMENT_INSUFFICIENT: Payment is short. Complete payment or use a positive credit term.
NON_CASH_PAYMENT_EXCEEDS_AMOUNT: Non-cash payments exceed the total by Rp {{excessAmount}}. Reduce non-cash payments before finalizing.
LEGACY_CHECKOUT_REVIEW_REQUIRED: Replace the legacy sequential discount before checkout.
STOCK_LOCATION_NOT_FOUND: Stock location not found. Choose an active location.
STOCK_LOCATION_INACTIVE: Stock location is inactive. Choose an active location.
STOCK_LOCATION_REQUIRED: Set up an active stock location in Reference Data before continuing.
OPENING_IMPORT_HEADER: CSV columns must be external_id, customer_name, as_of_date, opening_balance.
OPENING_IMPORT_UNKNOWN_CUSTOMER: Customer ID is unknown. Import the customer master first.
OPENING_IMPORT_INVALID_AMOUNT: Use nonnegative whole Rupiah within the supported range.
OPENING_IMPORT_CONFLICT: This customer already has an opening balance with a different date or amount.
